subject: Demo recap & proposed trial roadmap — Lumen AI POC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@lumenai.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (Lumen AI)

Hi Alex & team,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and helpful context on the latency-sensitive inference workloads and the regulatory constraints around audit logging. As promised, below is a concise recap of the demo plus a proposed trial (POC) roadmap so you can circulate internally.

Demo highlights (quick):
- Model compatibility: verified Redwood runtime supports the transformer family you showed (8B-13B variants) with quantized 4-bit options.
- Performance: streaming generation, KV cache reuse to reduce tail latency on repeat prompts.
- Observability: per-token cost breakdown, per-request latency heatmaps, and per-route tracing in the Console.

Proposed POC objective:
- Objective: Validate production latency (p95) <= 250ms for typical queries and end-to-end cost per inference within projected budget, plus verification of logging/audit controls for compliance.

Success criteria (please confirm/adjust):
1) Latency: p95 <= 250ms for sequences <= 512 tokens under a 30qps sustained test.
2) Throughput: Sustained 30 qps with <5% error rate during peak window.
3) Cost: Per-inference cost aligns with the model/quantization profile in the attached outline (target +/- 15%).
4) Observability & Compliance: Access to audit logs, request tracing, and 90-day retention exportable to your SIEM.
5) Integration: App-level SDK integration working in staging with KV cache warm-up within 48 hours.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline (4-week default):
- Week 0 (Onboarding, 3 days): Account provisioning, API keys, VPC peering options, shared sample dataset ingestion. Owner: Redwood (Vanessa + Ben).
- Week 1 (Smoke & integration, 5 business days): SDK integration, simple end-to-end checks, validate auth and network. Owner: Lumen (Alex) + Redwood SE (Ben).
- Week 2 (Performance testing, 5 business days): Load testing, latency/throughput baselining, KV caching validations. Owner: Redwood SE + Lumen SRE.
- Week 3 (Failure/integration testing, 5 business days): Fault-injection, failover behavior, measuring degradation and fallback accuracy. Owner: Joint.
- Week 4 (Wrap & evaluation, 3 days): Results, final report with recommended configs and next-step pricing for production.

Owner roles (suggested):
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (AM) — engagement/coordination; Ben Carter (SE) — technical lead; Rachel Kim (CS) — rollout support.
- Lumen AI: Alex Novak — systems lead; Procurement (procurement@lumenai.com) — contracting; Security lead (TBD) — compliance validation.

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (detailed test plan + metrics), sample scripts.

Next steps (ask):
- Please confirm the success criteria and ownership for the items above.
- Are there any additional compliance items we should include in Week 0 (e.g., specific export controls, encryption KMS preferences)?
- If the plan looks good we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week (I propose Tue 2026-09-21 10:00 PT).

If you prefer a compressed timeline (3 weeks) we can run setup and initial performance tests in parallel — happy to propose an accelerated schedule once you confirm that's desired.

Thanks — looking forward to moving ahead.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the plan. A few quick clarifications before we lock timeline: 

1) Cost breakdown: will we get a token-level cost breakdown and per-route attribution in real time? Our finance team needs that to model TCO during the POC.
2) Data residency: we need to ensure logs/audit data remain in us-east-1. Can Redwood guarantee regional retention and provide export hooks?
3) Sample data: what format/sample volume do you need for realistic warm-up? We own a 10k-query anonymized set we can share.
4) Accelerated timeline: we want to try compressing to 3 weeks if possible. Would that reduce validation quality?

I'll loop in procurement here — they will want the SOW and any short-term trial terms. Procurement, please advise if you need any additional legal wording for a time-limited trial.

If the 3-week accelerated plan is feasible, tentatively accept Tue 2026-09-21 10:00 PT for kickoff pending procurement review.

Thanks,
Alex Novak
Director of Platform Engineering, Lumen AI
alex.novak@lumenai.com | +1 628-555-9876

Hi Alex — looping in a few quick operational answers and a slightly compressed timeline option.

Answers:
- Token-level and per-route cost attribution: yes — Console exposes token breakdowns and per-route cost attribution. We can provision a billing view for your finance team and export CSVs daily during the trial.
- Data residency & logs: we can provision the trial in us-east-1 and retain audit logs there. We support log export to your S3 or to a partner SIEM; default retention is 90 days but can be extended.
- Sample data: the anonymized 10k-query set will be perfect. JSON lines or CSV with prompt/expected-output columns works best. We also have small scripts to convert formats.

Accelerated 3-week option (parallelized):
- Week 0 (Onboarding, 2 days): account + network setup (Redwood infra team).
- Week 1 (Integration + parallel perf): SDK integration + start initial perf tests (Redwood SE + Lumen SRE).
- Week 2 (Full perf + failover): Full load testing + fault-injection, wrap-up analysis (Redwood + Lumen).

Tradeoffs: compressed schedule reduces the buffer for unexpected infra work but we will run smoke tests concurrently with initial performance runs to catch issues early. Ben will act as the technical lead for the POC on our side.

Attachments: redwood-sla-exhibit.pdf, trial-sow.docx (SOW is time-limited trial language + acceptance criteria).

DocuSign: I’ve uploaded the trial SOW to DocuSign for signature: https://www.docusign.com/some-docusign-link-for-trial-sow

If that all sounds good, Vanessa can circulate the SOW and we’ll schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
